reviews.text: Excellent service, friendly atmosphere, and very good customer service. They are very kind and always try to help you when you have questions.
Very professional and knowledgeable about animals. If you have any questions, they answer them and are very helpful. Good prices and good products.
Very rude and unreliable seller. Please ask for a receipt for everything before leaving.

Terrible seller. He mistreated my girlfriend because of her complaint about a lizard in poor condition. He treated her terribly, insulting her and being rude. You have to demand the purchase receipt and warranty; he won't give you anything. He's a shameless crook. Don't buy anything from him, not even crickets, please.

We bought a lizard with health problems at this store. The seller, Poco, was only concerned with not refunding the money. He was very irritable about the situation and showed no interest in either the reptile or the buyer. He was very rude and unprofessional. Furthermore, at the time of purchase, he told my son that he couldn't give him the invoice and that he would send it in two days, but almost a month passed. We only returned to complain about the situation, and then he finally sent it. Poco, the seller, is serious but very rude. We tried to reach an agreement, but he wouldn't understand. We will have to resort to [unclear - possibly "reputable" or "unprofessional"]. The legal way to proceed in such a situation... We do not recommend this store to anyone, and if you are forced to go there, (take all necessary precautions and collect all your purchase documents). (Beware) Unreliable seller when making a claim regarding a purchase and warranty.

A negligent business. Anyone thinking of buying a budgie should know they are infected with a bacterial virus. The shop staff said it wasn't their problem and that they couldn't tell if an animal was sick or not. However, they then mentioned having one budgie with a bad eye and another that was also sick, which they put in a separate cage to avoid infecting the others, but it doesn't matter because the virus is airborne. Furthermore, they said they weren't quarantining, so they're probably all sick, and those that aren't are incubating it. My friend bought a budgie here and I know she also wrote a review, but something she didn't mention is that the budgie weighed 10 grams less than the minimum weight the vet considers acceptable (which is 35 grams; the budgie she got weighed 27). Not to mention that it had an inflamed liver due to the virus. These people also told my friend they weren't responsible and that if she died, they'd give her a 50% discount on her next purchase—like swapping one go-go dancer for another is a joke. You're a disgrace.
Absolutely despicable

I'm giving it one star because I can't give it less.
Exactly two weeks ago, I bought a blue budgie from Biosfera, and honestly, it's been a horrible experience. Two days after bringing it home, it started losing its tail feathers, had seizures, and exhibited very strange behavior. We took it to an exotic animal vet immediately, and after numerous tests and medication, they told us it probably came already sick from the store, because certain viruses in birds can take a while to manifest and are very difficult to detect.

We've spent around €200 on vet bills, medication, and hospitalization in just 15 days. Four days ago, it worsened considerably, and they had to admit it. This morning, it died.

The worst part of all was the way the store treated us. When I went to explain the situation, they basically told me they "couldn't do anything," insisting that a vet checks the animals every month (something I honestly find very hard to believe given the state the budgie was in). Furthermore, they constantly obstructed my complaint, stalling and complicating everything to avoid taking responsibility.

We're not talking about an object; we're talking about an animal that has suffered immensely and a family that has spent a fortune trying to save it. I find it outrageous to sell animals in that condition and then completely wash their hands of the matter when something like this happens.

A newly purchased baby bird was sick and near death, having epileptic seizures, and they never noticed??? Not even a month old and the "pet" shop did nothing about it. Dead fish and sick animals. They speak without knowledge, and the "supposed veterinarian" who sees the animals every... "month" is a "friend" of the shop owner; he's not even a professional in the field, and his solution is to let the bird die.

We went to buy a parakeet that seemed to be in perfect condition. The surprise came when, after just three days, it started getting sick. These things happen. After several visits to the vet, we found that the pet store offered no solution for the parakeet's serious decline. Their only solution was to let it die and offer us a 50% discount on the next one. That's how much they care for animals.

Their argument was that a close friend who is a veterinarian visits them every month. This will be the last purchase we make.
Excellent service.
Excellent, I highly recommend it! 👌🏼🤩 The service and treatment are the best. Thank you! 🫂 …
Good people, they really like talking to you and helping you choose.
An eco-friendly shop with great service, it educates you and offers alternative environmental products. Very cool. Thanks!

In the end, we didn't buy anything. We were going to get a parakeet, but we didn't dare because of the care it requires. The employee was incredibly helpful and gave us all the explanations we needed. I found the prices reasonable. I recommend it.

We bought a cockatiel a month ago. The staff were very helpful and explained the proper diet and how to gradually introduce new foods, since the baby had just stopped eating formula and needed to get used to it little by little and learn to eat on its own. In my opinion, they knew a lot about the subject, so a 10 out of 10...

It's the best pet shop I know. They have everything and always give me great advice about my water turtle.
They're very professional and friendly.

I've been there several times, and I admit I ask a lot of questions, especially since I'm a complete novice when it comes to aquariums and fish. This gentleman who served me wasn't the first to show apathy, a lack of interest, and a complete lack of friendliness. He practically called me clumsy, useless, and annoying because of the questions I asked. So far, you clearly lack any empathy or understanding when you're behind a counter. And I admit my questions were very simple, but to be told the answer with such a lack of kindness is unacceptable. The store itself seemed well-stocked and had a wide variety of very cool fish. That's my opinion, and I'm sharing it. Thank you.
A nice friendly local pet store. Knowledgeable owner for beginners. Great for kids pets. Not an aquarium specialist but still a very helpful owner who helped me solve a lighting stand design problem
I always find what I need for my pets and they advise me on everything! I'm very happy with this store.
It's gone downhill a lot, overall, and there's a smell of poor hygiene. I'm sorry.
They have a good variety, it's a good store.

I just walked in, I wanted to check out Otosinclus.
I glanced quickly at the aquariums and found four dead fish, one of which I think had dropsy... anyway... I didn't even bother looking at the rest of the place.
It's good, but the place is a bit small and the opening hours are short.
It's important to consult professionals.

The service was impeccable; they were incredibly attentive and knowledgeable about feeding the birds.

100% recommended.
Excellent service, simple, clear, and knowledgeable. I highly recommend this store.
I go there very often, the service is fantastic, they give excellent advice, they have practically everything for our pets including grooming services, I recommend it 100%.
I bought an aquarium filter, everything's great.
